synthetic_auxiliary_ablation.description: Scaled synthetic counterpart of the CodeContests/TinyLlama ablation from Table 2: meaningful auxiliary variables increase accepted teacher-verified tokens compared with an independent multi-token predictor. Reference values are the paper's Table 2 numbers; reproduced scores use the tracked synthetic teacher.

synthetic_restricted_compute_n8.description: Scaled synthetic counterpart of the taxi restricted-compute ablation from Table 10 at proposal length N=8: auxiliary-conditioned O-PTP should keep longer correct prefixes than independent prediction at the same model scale. Reference values are the paper's Table 10 numbers; reproduced scores use the tracked synthetic teacher.
